summary: Short residential kerb at an intersection, homes 14-19 m away on its own side.

best_section.where: North kerb of Carinya Street, between the bend and the T-junction

drivers.seclusion: Houses and pools line the north side 14-19 m from the kerb; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; kerb is clear of cars, room for a van beside the lane likely.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street at a junction, low volume.
drivers.convention: No parked campers seen; no signs.

flags: Witton Creek 54 m away, lowest 34 m so not flood-prone
sun_shade: Patchy tree shade on the north side, open to the south sun from across the road.
